notes.title: Hentai Harem Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey all!
Harem House is releasing its very first game; Hentai Harem!

This casual, relaxing puzzle game will be releasing in just two weeks on March 27th at 1pm PDT. Make sure you wishlist ahead of time to be able to grab the game the moment it comes out.

We'll be releasing for just 99 cents USD. Less than a dollar! For that you get 10 different puzzles of 10 different beautiful girls, and each girl comes with at least one (but usually two!) different states of undress. Unlock them all and fill out your gallery so you can come back and see them at any time.

We've been working hard on getting this game ready for you all, so we hope you're as excited as we are.
Two weeks to go!
